fixture.processing: Grayscale bytes from the actual global-coordinate CT surface render, without intensity changes

failure_injection: Writer rejects the final 4-byte or 8-byte zero next-IFD link when BufWriter flushes it
before: TIFF and BigTIFF encoding return success despite the final buffered write failing during Drop
after: Final buffered write failures are returned to the caller
pixel_roundtrip: All 256 real CT pixel bytes match for standard TIFF and BigTIFF
limitations: Failure injected through Write/Seek; no filesystem filled deliberately
Explicit flush reports buffered I/O errors; it does not request fsync or power-loss durability
